standard_prerequisites.name: Generalization theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Final step: from Gamma' proves subst(A,c,x) with x not free in Gamma' to the universal closure.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1325-1329): if Gamma proves A and c is a constant not occurring in Gamma, then for some variable x not in A, Gamma proves forall x subst(A,c,x) by a proof not involving c.

Proof (lines 1331-1348): take a proof A_1..A_n of A from Gamma, pick x outside all A_i, and replace c by x throughout; the displayed three-case check shows the new sequence is still a proof (axioms map to axioms, members of Gamma are unchanged since c is not in Gamma, and MP steps map to MP steps); the used subset Gamma' has x free in none of its formulas, so the Generalization theorem and monotonicity close.
proof_roadmap: Substitute the variable for the constant throughout the proof.
Three-case verification that the sequence remains a proof.
Generalization theorem plus monotonicity to close.
